scope: All times use New York local minutes on the row's trading date. Price distances are normalized by the serialized ordinary Mean SessionPath U+D forecast width, not by AVR or orange rectangles. All four methods and the two event definitions overlap dates.

identification.eventKind: WICK_FIRST is the first strict high/low breach of either boundary; CLOSE_FIRST is the first completed close strictly outside either boundary. They are two alternative observations, never independent cases.
identification.side: U/D for resolved first event; NONE for no qualifying event; AMBIGUOUS for a first wick candle crossing both boundaries with unknowable intrabar order.
identification.type: WICK_ONLY means the first wick candle closed inside/on the box; CLOSE_OUTSIDE means it closed strictly outside on the event side. NO_BREAK and AMBIGUOUS retain excluded observations.
identification.firstWickSide/firstWickOpenMinute: First strict wick event identification, shared on both alternative rows.
identification.firstCloseSide/firstCloseOpenMinute: First completed outside-close identification, shared on both alternative rows. The first close side can differ from the first wick side.

forecast.method: nyOwnWide, nyOwnExact, nyPriorWide or nyPriorExact. Primary timing model research uses nyOwnWide with n>=50.
forecast.n: Count of distinct strictly earlier matched dates used to fit the box. It is not the sample count of the new breakout group.
forecast.avr: That day's frozen historical AVR in price points, retained as provenance; extension targets use full forecast width.
forecast.open: 08:30 decision open serialized to six decimals.
forecast.meanUp/meanDown: Previously reconstructed earlier-only Mean side distances serialized to six decimals.
forecast.upper/lower/width: upper=open+meanUp; lower=open-meanDown; width=upper-lower. No tick rounding is added.

signalTiming.signalOpenMinute/signalOpenTime: Opening timestamp of the signal five-minute candle.
signalTiming.signalCloseMinute/signalCloseTime: Signal fully observable five minutes later. Primary timing bins use this completion time.
signalTiming.timeBlock/timeBlockLabel: Floor the completed time into half-hour blocks. A 09:25 opening candle confirms at09:30 and belongs to09:30–09:59. A15:55 candle confirms16:00 and is terminal, not15:30–15:59.
signalTiming.signalIndex: Zero-based index within90candles opening08:30 through15:55; -1 means no event.
signalTiming.signalOpen/signalHigh/signalLow/signalCl: Raw OHLC of signal candle, null for no event.
signalTiming.nextOpen: Actual opening price of the next in-window five-minute candle, null if none.
signalTiming.firstCloseAfterWickMinutes: Elapsed candle time between first wick and first outside close; null if either absent.

strength.closeOvershoot: U:(signalClose-upper)/width; D:(lower-signalClose)/width. Signed and can be negative for wick-only.
strength.wickOvershootBin/closeOvershootBin: Floor max(0,overshoot) to a0.10full-width step, with only tiny arithmetic-residue snapping.14% maps10%;27% maps20%. Wick-only and outside-close types remain separate.

futureExtension.laterBars: Number of actual candles strictly after signal candle; zero terminal observations must be excluded from future-extension distributions.
futureExtension.maxLaterSameSideOvershoot: Maximum same-side distance beyond original boundary among later candles, divided by width and floored at zero. This is not additional distance beyond the trigger candle.
futureExtension.maxLaterSameSideMultiple: Maximum later same-side opposite-edge coordinate:1+signed boundary overshoot. Can be below1 if every later candle stays inside the boundary. Null with no later candle.
futureExtension.additionalBeyondSignalExtreme: Nonnegative additional later extreme beyond signal candle's own high(U)/low(D), divided by width. Includes zero improvement. Terminal laterBars0 rows retain0 but are ineligible for continuation distributions.
futureExtension.maxSessionSameSideOvershoot: Maximum boundary overshoot in the full NY window, including all pre-signal candles. Descriptive only; do not treat as a post-signal outcome.

eod.eodClose/eodCloseKnownMinute: Close of15:55–16:00 candle, known at960. No16:00opening candle is used.
eod.eodBoxState: INSIDE, ABOVE or BELOW the original box. Equality belongs inside, with the standard1e-9arithmetic epsilon.
eod.eodState: INSIDE, SAME_SIDE or OPPOSITE_SIDE relative to resolved event direction. Null if no resolved event.
eod.finalSignedFromOpen: U:(eodClose-open)/width; D:(open-eodClose)/width. Positive is continuation relative to decision open.
eod.finalOutsideDistance: Signed final overshoot from same-side boundary. Negative means finish back across that boundary.

targets.multiple/target: For multiplem, Utarget=lower+m×width and Dtarget=upper−m×width.1.50means50%of full width beyond boundary, not150%beyond. Values1.2,1.3,1.4,1.5,1.75,2.0.
targets.triggerReached: Signal candle's wick touched/passed target, including equality.
targets.touchedBeforeSignal: Any earlier in-window candle touched the same directional target.
targets.touchedBeforeFirstClose: Same pre-signal field for CLOSE_FIRST only; null for WICK_FIRST. Prevents old wick hits being treated as future opportunities at first outside close.
targets.nextOpenGap: Target not previously touched, but next actual opening price is at/beyond target. Separately excluded from pending.
targets.noRemaining: Resolved event has no later in-window candle.
targets.pending: Resolved event, untouched through signal and next opening price, with at least one later candle.
targets.laterHit: Any later candle touches target, regardless of pending eligibility. Do not substitute it for pendingHit.
targets.pendingHit: Later target touch among eligible pending observations; null when not pending.
targets.laterHitOpenMinute/laterHitCloseMinute: Earliest later target-hit candle's opening/completion timestamp; null if no later touch.
targets.firstTargetHitOpenMinute: First target-touch candle in full NY window, including before signal.

provenance.cohortSHA256/maxEarlierDate: Hash of saved matched-date list and latest member. Every list count equalsn and every date strictly predates forecast date.
provenance.sourceOHLC_SHA256: SHA256 of JSON-serialized{date,contract,bars}from authoritative source loader/research-days artifact.
provenance.studySource/sourceLabel: Original study path and source-day description. source-files.json hashes canonical input model/forecast/study/code files; independent audit includes original CSV endpoint parity.
